attchmntText: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 (the 'Unaudited Financial Results'), along with the Limited Review Report.
voiceSummary: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, during a Board meeting on November 14, 2026. The Limited Review Report issued by H H Dedhia & Associates is unmodified. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 509.42 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 30.79 lakhs and a profit for the period of Rs. 20.42 lakhs. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations stood at Rs. 10,328.46 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 187.03 lakhs and a profit for the period of Rs. 127.15 lakhs. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were Rs. 24,058.53 lakhs. The Board also approved a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Health Care at Home India Private Limited and Saarathi Healthcare Private Limited.

attchmntText: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: QMS Medical Allied Services Limited will host an earnings conference call for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. Management representatives include Mr. Mahesh Makhija, Chairman and Managing Director, and Mr. Mohit Tamhankar, Director Compliance. Dial-in details are available on the company website.
